summary.headline: Aether Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 27% YoY to INR3,266 million, with EBITDA up 31% to INR1,028 million and margin at 31%.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 27% YoY to INR3,266 million and EBITDA rose 31% to INR1,028 million, with EBITDA margin at 31% versus 30% a year ago. PAT grew 33% YoY to INR627 million, a 19% margin. Management highlighted the Dow Chemical silicones research partnership, Site 5 (Magnum, Panoli) starting commercial LSM sales, and a mix shift toward CEM and CRAMS. The company also received the final insurance claim for the November 2023 fire-related fixed asset losses, and working capital remains elevated due to inventory build.

segments.name: CEM (Contract Exclusive Manufacturing)
segments.commentary: Management says CEM runs at EBITDA margins of 28-30%; company-level CEM margin guidance is 28-30%. Long-term take-or-pay/minimum-volume offtakes cited with Baker Hughes, Seqens, Saudi Aramco and Milliken.

segments.name: CRAMS
segments.commentary: Management targets CEM plus CRAMS at 70%+ of revenue in the next couple of years, versus about 50% currently. Management said CRAMS is 'about 50%' already.

segments.name: LSM (Large-scale manufacturing)
segments.commentary: Volume fell 22.5% YoY as some lines at Site 3 moved to CEM; management said pricing rose 22.5% and demand is intact. LSM expected to be about 35% of top line in coming years.

segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.commentary: Revenue about INR1,000 million in the quarter per analyst question, roughly 20% of business per management. Baker Hughes is the largest customer; Site 4 producing about INR70 crore currently versus about INR45 crore at the start.

guidance_outlook: FY27 capex guided at INR3,000-3,500 million, mainly for Site 5 and the new R&D site.
Site 5 (Magnum) LSM products expected to contribute revenue from Q2 FY27; first three LSM products priced around $30-40/kg.
Semiconductor materials line at Site 5 (45 tonnes/month, three streams of 15 tonnes) targeted online by end-September 2026.
Working capital days expected to decline progressively as Site 3++ revenue materialises and Site 5 comes on stream.
Site 5 Phase 1 asset turn expected at 1.5-1.75 once fully operational; total investment INR2,200-2,300 crore; Phase 2 in FY2030.
Larger R&D facility (around 15 labs, ~160 cumulative fume hoods) on track for commissioning in FY2028.
Company is applying for India's ISM 2.0 incentive; structure not yet clear, no benefit promised.
capex_capacity: Site 3++ commissioned end-February 2026, ramping faster than planned; Milliken supply agreement tied to this site.
Magnum (Site 5, Panoli): 16 production blocks commissioned in phases; Phase 1 now online; several customers have completed pre-audits.
Site 3 running a pharma intermediate at 10-15 MT/month as a temporary measure ahead of Site 5.
Interim R&D expansion complete: additional fume hoods and a new 400 MHz NMR in service.
demand_pricing: Management said demand signal is the strongest seen, with rising urgency from Western customers, especially Europe, to shift manufacturing to India.
In Q1 FY27 the company onboarded 10 new marquee clients and cleared more than nine customer and certification audits.
Low-dielectric monomer/silane coupling agent line for 5G/AI PCBs: initial capacity 400 tonnes, expected to grow 3x by 2030, average product value about $50/kg. No firm order book disclosed.
Management says LSM prices corrected in recent months and company remains competitive; it cited holding market share even after 30-35% price cuts post-COVID.
Oil and gas: management states the segment grew from zero to about 20% of business over two years.

qa_highlights.question: Are there orders in hand for semiconductor products, and which chemistries are involved?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to disclose the order book or product count for competitive reasons, citing a focused set of high-value molecules that draw on core process chemistries.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Dow collaboration scope, timeline, and commercialisation path?
qa_highlights.answer: Dow is an exclusive multi-year research partner for silicone manufacturing technologies in India, with R&D and pilot scale-up at Surat; management gave no revenue date and flagged pilot completion, a commercial framework, and a possible dedicated site as milestones.

qa_highlights.question: What is the semiconductor chemical commercialisation timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Site 3 has one stream making semiconductor chemicals with qualification batches complete and small orders being delivered; the large Site 5 stream of 45 tonnes/month is targeted for end-September 2026.

qa_highlights.question: How is pricing protected against Chinese competition for new molecules?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said LSM market share was held even when prices fell 30-35% post-COVID; the company says it remains competitive after recent price corrections, and LSM will be about 35% of revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Is Site 5 LSM capacity earning more or less margin after moving to CEM, and is LSM demand unserved?
qa_highlights.answer: LSM volume fell 22.5% as lines moved to CEM at Site 3, while pricing rose 22.5%; management says demand is intact and no margin split was given.

qa_highlights.question: Can revenue from Baker Hughes and Milliken be quantified for the next 2-3 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to quantify, but said Baker Hughes has added new products under an exclusive manufacturing arrangement and Milliken has a multi-year supply agreement for one product.

risks_watch: Dow programme is at an early research stage; no revenue timeline and no commercial framework signed yet.
Working capital intensity remains high, with inventory elevated for Site 3++ and Site 5 semi-finished goods and raw materials.
Execution bandwidth across concurrent expansions (Site 5, R&D site, pilot plant, Dow programme); management cited safety and execution as key risks.
Chinese price competition in LSM products; LSM volumes fell 22.5% YoY.
Semiconductor and silicone revenue dates remain undisclosed; the ISM 2.0 benefit is unconfirmed.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on strategy and new platforms, with specific figures on margins and capacity. Evasive on order books, product names, customer revenue and timelines for the semiconductor and silicone programmes, citing competitive reasons.

Dow choosing us as its exclusive research partner in India validates our process chemistry and technology competencies and scale capabilities.
So, for the competitive reasons, we don't break out our order book or the product count for the program at this stage.
Phase 1 has become online and once fully operational, we expect asset turn of 1.5 to 1.75.
We expect a progressive decline in working capital days as revenues from Site 3++ materialize and Site 5 comes on stream.
But that's primarily on the back of us dedicating some of the production lines to the CEM business model, which we've done in site 3.
